title: GIOTTO poll replaces a queued light/brightness request
description:
- Location: indigo_drivers/aux_giotto/indigo_aux_giotto.driver:89-91,133-145,239-240,272. Generated call-site check: indigo_aux_giotto.c:740-743 and441-477. - Severity: medium; confidence: high; category: functional/concurrency. Owner: coordinator; status: open; nonblocking follow-up. - Evidence: after panel_get_state I/O, a changed state or recovery from poll_alert calls giotto_publish_light, overwriting the light switch and brightness value AND target, then sets both properties OK. No per-property BUSY/pending guard exists. A concurrent bus-thread change sets BUSY and stores the request before its queued handler runs; that handler later reads the same overwritten switch or number.target. - Impact: an external panel-state change or poll-alert recovery concurrent with a client request can replace that request with old readback, resulting in a successful handler sending a different value. No race reproduction performed. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-6). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
